purpose: Adds Low-Quality Image Placeholders (LQIP) and dominant color extraction for lazy-loaded images, replacing the hardcoded gray SVG placeholder with four user-selectable placeholder types (None, SVG, Dominant Color, LQIP) and full backward compatibility.
riskRationale: The dual-storage pattern (wppo_placeholder_info written non-atomically alongside wppo_img_info) persists from prior reviews, risking transient data loss under concurrent conversion and loading all LQIP data URIs on every uncached page. WebP source images with the default 'webp' format never generate placeholders — a functional gap in the most common configuration. The atomic wppo_img_info source of truth partially mitigates the dual-storage risk, but both issues affect correctness at scale.
breakingChanges: replacePlaceholderWithSVG boolean replaced with placeholderType dropdown (backward compat handled via PHP migration in Image_Optimisation::__construct())

text: The implementation correctly applies all previously-requested fixes (ob_start error handling at class-img-converter.php:592, GIF fallback logging at class-img-converter.php:385, load-event ordering in lazyload.js). However, two architecture-level issues from prior reviews remain unresolved: the non-atomic dual-storage pattern for placeholder persistence (wppo_placeholder_info) creates race conditions and memory overhead, and WebP source images with the default 'webp' format never enter the placeholder extraction path. Three minor issues (JS code duplication, React dead code, unnecessary filesystem I/O) are also present.

reasoning: Two previously-reported issues block merge: (1) CRITICAL — dual-storage race condition in Img_Converter with non-atomic writes to wppo_placeholder_info, which also loads all LQIP data URIs into memory on every request; (2) IMPORTANT — WebP source images with the default 'webp' conversion format never extract placeholders because imagecreatefromwebp() is only called in the AVIF conversion branch. The dual-storage refactor spans multiple methods and files, making auto-fix inappropriate.

message: ob_start() return value is now checked with early return on failure, preventing corrupted LQIP data URIs from failed output buffering — correctly fixes the previously-reported issue.
GIF placeholder extraction catch block now calls Log::add() regardless of WP_DEBUG mode, ensuring failures are recorded in the activity log.
Load event listener is correctly registered before assigning el.src in both IntersectionObserver and scroll-fallback paths, preventing missed load events on cached images.

Backward compatibility migration from replacePlaceholderWithSVG to placeholderType is handled in PHP (constructor) with whitelist validation in get_placeholder_type(), ensuring zero breakage for existing configs.
Dominant color placeholder correctly uses a 1x1 transparent SVG as src and sets data-wppo-dominant-color for JS to apply as background-color, avoiding a colored SVG filling the container.

Placeholder extraction condition was correctly decoupled from WebP/AVIF encode outcomes — placeholder data is captured whenever the source was decoded into a GdImage, independent of conversion success.
clean_placeholder_on_delete() correctly iterates all registered resized versions from attachment metadata, handling cleanup for both wppo_img_info and wppo_placeholder_info.

Dual-storage pattern persists: store_placeholder_data() writes to both wppo_img_info (deferred atomic via update_img_info_atomic with MySQL GET_LOCK) and wppo_placeholder_info (immediate via update_placeholder_option() using a bare read-modify-write cycle without locking). Under concurrent Action Scheduler conversion jobs, update_placeholder_option() can silently overwrite entries added by another process. Additionally, get_placeholder_info() loads all LQIP data URIs for the entire media library into memory on every uncached page request. clean_placeholder_on_delete() at line 737 reads wppo_img_info via get_option() instead of self::get_img_info(), potentially missing deferred-but-not-yet-committed entries and leaving orphaned placeholder data.
suggestion: Eliminate the duplicate wppo_placeholder_info option entirely. Store placeholder data (dominant_color, lqip) directly in wppo_img_info keys via the existing atomic deferred-commit pattern (update_img_info_atomic). Change get_placeholder_info() to delegate to self::get_img_info(). Fix clean_placeholder_on_delete() to read from self::get_img_info() instead of get_option(). Remove update_placeholder_option(), get_placeholder_info() standalone option read, and the second write in store_placeholder_data().

message: When the source image is WebP and format is 'webp' (the default and most common setting), $image remains null at the placeholder extraction point. The IMAGETYPE_WEBP case only enters the imagecreatefromwebp() block for 'avif' or 'both' formats — the 'webp' branch skips GD creation entirely. Since the check at line 314 requires $image instanceof GdImage, extract_dominant_color() and generate_lqip() are never called. After the placeholder block, control reaches 'return true' at line 321, so WebP originals with 'webp' format produce no placeholder data.
suggestion: Extract placeholder data from WebP sources regardless of target format. Before the 'return true' at line 321, when $image is null and format is 'webp', create a temporary GD resource from the WebP file specifically for placeholder extraction, then destroy it.

message: The dominant color background and LQIP blur application/cleanup logic (~45 lines) is fully duplicated across the IntersectionObserver path and the scroll-fallback path. Both apply identical data-wppo-dominant-color background styling, LQIP CSS class toggling, and load-event cleanup — any future placeholder behavior change must be mirrored in both code paths.
suggestion: Extract the shared placeholder application and cleanup logic into helper functions (applyPlaceholderBeforeLoad and cleanupPlaceholderOnLoad) scoped to the loadImages closure. Call these from both the IntersectionObserver and scroll-fallback paths.

message: The explicit placeholderType default on lines 33-35 (with backward-compat fallback to replacePlaceholderWithSVG) is immediately overridden by the ...options spread on line 44. Since options always contains placeholderType from PHP defaults (class-main.php:140), the backward-compat fallback is dead code — only reachable if options.placeholderType is explicitly undefined, which never happens.
suggestion: Move the ...options spread before the explicit placeholderType so the explicit backward-compat computation wins, or remove the JS fallback entirely and rely solely on the PHP-side migration in Image_Optimisation::__construct().

message: The data-src to local path resolution (Util::get_local_path()) runs unconditionally for every call to get_placeholder_src_for_image(), including when placeholderType is 'svg'. For SVG placeholders, the resolved path is never used because the function returns early at line 1917 with generate_svg_base64(). This performs unnecessary filesystem I/O on every lazy-loaded image when the default SVG placeholder is active.
suggestion: Move the 'svg' placeholder type early return (lines 1916–1918) BEFORE the data-src path resolution block (lines 1905–1914) to avoid unnecessary Util::get_local_path() calls for the SVG placeholder type.
